summary: The default InfoBufferSize for split-stream logging is now built with resource.MustParse("0") instead of NewQuantity(0) plus a String() call to prime the cache. Because ParseQuantity now caches the string itself (and String() no longer mutates), the result is the same zero DecimalSI quantity with s="0". A line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: Default InfoBufferSize built via MustParse instead of NewQuantity plus String()
reason: Equivalent zero DecimalSI quantity with cached string "0"; the removed String() call is replaced by ParseQuantity caching, so only the construction path differs.
